title: fespalier · App health
description: Start here: is the app fast, and does it work? One tile per question; green is good, amber needs attention, red is bad.

panels.title: How to read this
panels.markdownContent:
**Start here.** Each tile answers one question about the app chosen in **App**, over the time range at the top.
🟢 good · 🟠 needs attention · 🔴 bad · grey: not enough data yet. Hover ⓘ next to a title for what it means
and what to do; click a row for the details. *Verdicts, in words* says the same without colour.

panels.title: Do screens open quickly?
panels.description: Time from a tap to the new screen's first frame, for the slowest 5 % of opens. Good: under 300 ms. If not: open Screens; slow ones usually wait on a guard.dart or build too much in page.dart.

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 THEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 END AS p95_ms FROM "default" WHERE service_name = '$service'

panels.title: Does content load quickly?
panels.description: How long data.dart takes to deliver a screen's content, slowest 5 %. Good: under 1 s. If not: Screens lists each data.dart; cache it (dataCache), load less, or show what you have first.

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 THEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 END AS p95_ms FROM "default" WHERE service_name = '$service'

panels.title: Do actions finish quickly?
panels.description: How long an action.dart takes, from the tap to its result, slowest 5 %. Good: under 1 s. If not: Actions shows which one; consider optimistic() so the screen answers at once.

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 THEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 END AS p95_ms FROM "default" WHERE service_name = '$service'

panels.title: How many screens were viewed?
panels.description: Screens that opened in this time range (back and tab switches included, refreshes not). It tells you how much the other tiles are based on.

queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS views FROM "default" WHERE fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome = 'ok' AND fespalier_navigation_kind <> 'refresh' AND service_name = '$service'

panels.title: How often does content fail to load?
panels.description: Share of finished data.dart loads that threw. Good: under 1 %. If not: Errors shows the error type and file; add a retry (data_retry) or an error.dart that lets people try again.

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) END AS failed_pct FROM "default" WHERE service_name = '$service'

panels.title: How often do actions fail?
panels.description: Share of action.dart runs that threw. Good: under 1 %. If not: Actions lists the failing action and Errors its error type; check its validate() and the server's answer.

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' AND fespalier_action_result = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) END AS failed_pct FROM "default" WHERE service_name = '$service'

panels.title: Did anything throw an uncaught error?
panels.description: Errors nothing caught (logged at ERROR or above). Good: none. If not: Errors lists them by type with the message; most come from a widget build or an unawaited Future.

queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS uncaught FROM "default" WHERE (UPPER(severity) IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL', 'CRITICAL') OR severity IN ('17', '18', '19', '20', '21', '22', '23', '24')) AND service_name = '$service'

panels.title: Did the app crash or freeze?
panels.description: Native crashes and 'app not responding' freezes on Android and iOS. Good: none; even one is worth a look. If not: Errors has the time; read the device log.

queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS crashes FROM "default" WHERE event_name IN ('device.crash', 'device.anr') AND service_name = '$service'

panels.title: Verdicts, in words
panels.description: The same checks as the tiles, said in words, so colour is never the only signal. 'Too few to judge' means fewer than 20 samples in this time range.

queries.query:
SELECT 'This app' AS app,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 300 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 1000 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 >= 1000 THEN CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 / 1000.0, 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' s' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ' ms' END END AS screens_open,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 1000 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 3000 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 >= 1000 THEN CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 / 1000.0, 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' s' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ' ms' END END AS content_loads,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 1000 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 3000 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 >= 1000 THEN CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 / 1000.0, 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' s' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ' ms' END END AS actions_finish,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation IN ('guard', 'redirect') AND fespalier_async = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation IN ('guard', 'redirect') AND fespalier_async = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation IN ('guard', 'redirect') AND fespalier_async = 'true' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 100 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation IN ('guard', 'redirect') AND fespalier_async = 'true' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 300 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation IN ('guard', 'redirect') AND fespalier_async = 'true' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 >= 1000 THEN CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation IN ('guard', 'redirect') AND fespalier_async = 'true' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 / 1000.0, 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' s' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation IN ('guard', 'redirect') AND fespalier_async = 'true' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ' ms' END END AS guard_wait,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'deferred' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'deferred' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'deferred' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 500 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'deferred' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 < 2000 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CASE WHEN approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'deferred' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 >= 1000 THEN CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'deferred' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 / 1000.0, 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' s' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'deferred' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || ' ms' END END AS code_download,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 1 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 5 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' %' END AS load_failures,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' AND fespalier_action_result = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 1 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' AND fespalier_action_result = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 5 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' AND fespalier_action_result = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'action' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' %' END AS action_failures,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 20 THEN '… Too few to judge (' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR) || ')' ELSE (CASE WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome = 'not_found' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 1 THEN '✓ Good · ' WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome = 'not_found' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) < 5 THEN '! Needs attention · ' ELSE '✗ Bad · ' END) || CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome = 'not_found' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS VARCHAR) || ' %' END AS dead_ends
FROM "default" WHERE service_name = '$service'

panels.title: Which screens are slowest?
panels.description: The five screens that take longest to open. Content is the data.dart load that follows. If one is red: open Screens and check its guard.dart and data.dart rows.

queries.query: SELECT fespalier_route AS route, SUM(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome = 'ok' AND fespalier_navigation_kind <> 'refresh' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS views, approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'navigate' AND fespalier_navigation_outcome <> 'superseded' THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS open_p95, approx_percentile_cont(CASE WHEN fespalier_operation = 'data' AND fespalier_data_state IN ('data', 'error') THEN duration END, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS content_p95 FROM "default" WHERE fespalier_route IS NOT NULL AND service_name = '$service' GROUP BY route ORDER BY open_p95 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

panels.title: What fails most?
panels.description: The five things that failed most often, with the file to open. A Check is a guard.dart, Content a data.dart, an Action an action.dart.

queries.query: SELECT fespalier_operation AS operation, fespalier_file AS file, fespalier_route AS route, error_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "default" WHERE span_status = 'ERROR' AND fespalier_operation IS NOT NULL AND service_name = '$service' GROUP BY operation, file, route, type ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
